positive_text: Location
negative_text: This place used to be good about five years ago, but unfortunately, the standard has deteriorated dramatically. It seems they have lowered their prices and opened the doors to just about anyone, and the overall environment has suffered as a result. The place is now extremely dirty and messy, with some residents leaving filthy, smelly clothes scattered around their rooms. There are people struggling with drug and alcohol problems, disruptive behaviour, and a general lack of consideration for others. Many appear to be staying long-term rather than being ordinary travellers or holidaymakers. The meals are incredibly basic and poor quality. Dinner is so cheap and unappealing that it feels more like a charity meal than something you'd expect from paid accommodation. To be fair, the Sydney staff do try to do a good job, and I acknowledge their efforts. However, the management appears to have little control over the standard of residents or the behaviour occurring on the premises. I've witnessed some extraordinary things, including someone running a power cord out of a window to charge an electric car parked in the driveway. Customer service is another major problem. The overseas customer service team can sometimes be helpful, but too often, instead of taking responsibility and resolving a complaint, they look for excuses and try to shift the blame back onto the customer. Questions such as why an issue wasn't reported earlier seem to take priority over actually addressing the problem. Management has apparently sent warnings about behaviour such as smoking drugs in rooms and urinating in bottles, yet the fact that such warnings are necessary tells you something about the environment. It's disappointing because this place had a good reputation years ago. The Sydney staff deserve credit for trying, but the overall management, cleanliness, resident standards, food quality and customer service have deteriorated significantly.

negative_text: Horrible experience checking in with Reyna and Sophia. I messaged them at 11:00 in the morning to let them know that I wanted dinner. I also completed the online check-in, uploaded all my details, and was told I would receive a door code. I arrived at the hotel at 7:00 pm and immediately emailed them and sent messages through Booking.com. Reyna ignored these messages until 7:42 pm. When I finally spoke to her, I was given a series of different and contradictory explanations. First, I was told that none of my emails or Booking.com messages had been received. When I showed her evidence that they had been sent, the explanations changed. I was then kept waiting for another 15 minutes while further explanations were given. I finally got through the door at around 8:00 pm. I went to get the dinner I had requested earlier, only to find that there was no dinner available. I went back to reception to speak to Reyna, and again I was given a series of explanations that contradicted what I had previously been told. I was left standing at reception with all my bags until approximately 8:20 pm. Reyna then gave me the wrong door code and refused to provide the contact details for her manager or supervisor. By contrast, the gentleman who is normally on the screen on a Friday night has always been excellent and provides a completely different level of customer service. My impression was that Reyna was worried about her handling of the situation being exposed, which is why I felt I was given different explanations, my questions weren't properly answered, and I was refused the manager's email address. This was an absolutely horrible experience. The whole situation was unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. Reyna's handling of the situation was extremely poor.

review_title: Don't go there if you expect minimal responsiveness from staff

negative_text: 1. Impossible to reach by phone, called a few times before and during my stay - nobody responded. 2. Made me install an app to get access. Would've never booked if knew this in advance. 3. Made me send them copy of my passport in Whatsapp. Very unsafe. 4. I let them know my check-in time, but nobody opened the door for me to enter. Some other guest let me in for check-in, even though I was calling and knocking and texting. 5. Wanted me to buy a towel instead of lending. Who BUYS towels when travelling? I wasn't informed about that and had to buy a towel in the city - other way, I would've brought my own. 6. I asked for a hair-dryer - they made me look for it myself in lockers in a corridor. For another guest, someone brought a hair-dryer in 2 PM (also unacceptable to enter a room that late). 7. VERY DIRTY BATHROOMS, they clean everyday, but that cleaning isn't good. 8. One washing machine and one dryer for the whole hostel. ONE! 9. Air con remote wasn't working, so I was freezing at night. Next day, needed to poke them 3 times during the day to send someone. That someone, in very poor English, brought another remote control, but didn't leave it in the room - said it's staff responsibility to set up temperature (seriously?) and he cannot leave us a working remote. I asked, why then there's a remote in a room, he said "I don't know" (not the answer staff should give). I had to repeat like 6 times that I want AC off, the guy just didn't seem to understand what I say. Took away working remote but left a faulty one anyway. I didn't understand what it was, completely. Noticed very poor communication skills from all staff. 10. 24-hours before the departure, I received an email with outdated information regarding their towels, the same one provided to me before that's why I didn't bring my own towel. 11.

positive_text: • Curtains and wall partitions provide privacy. • No eating/drinking in bed room and quiet time after 10 p.m. make it peaceful. • Free towels and hairdryers are convenient.($10 deposit ) • Clean for a backpackers hostel. • Dinner portions are generous and filling. • Simple but appreciated breakfast (toast, cereal, coffee, tea).
negative_text: • Dinner must be booked by 4 p.m., but this wasn’t clearly mentioned. • Tried to book dinner through the app they provided, but it didn’t work; only managed to reserve after contacting a different phone number sent after signing the contract. • The phone number and email address listed in the contract didn’t work — no reply to messages, and the phone disconnects immediately. • Only one ensuite bathroom for 14 women (7 bunk beds), which is too few. • Extra shower room outside helps, but no power outlet for hairdryers. • Each bed has two power outlets, but one is already used for the light, so only one is actually available.

positive_text: Not a thing. You could not pay me to stay here again.
negative_text: FIRST RED FLAG, the reception staff are on a tiny tablet. They are not on site and most likely out of country, using a green screen of an office setting to try and project some sort of professionalism. SECOND RED FLAG, an older lady checked in before us and had specifically requested a female only room at a different Azzurro Hotel. They had overbooked, had zero beds left, and sent her to Darling Harbour location. She had to accept a room with males because when she requested a discount for the trouble, she was told you can stay at the original "hotel" (that was overbooked) or forfeit your payment because they dont offer refunds. THIRD RED FLAG, We had to get our bedding changed before we could even sit down after a 9 hour drive. There was hair and stains on the linen. NONE of the beds had been changed before our arrival. The listing says it is a HOTEL. It is barely a hostel. We booked a Private Room with shared toilet/shower, which reads as shared between the 4 people in the room. It is communal showers and toilets in the middle of the building. The room has an air-conditioner but the staff have the remote, for reasons unknown. We had to call and ask them to send the staff member to change the temperature because the AC was set to fan only. When they arrived, they acted like they couldnt work out the remote. We had to ask for the remote and change the settings ourselves The showers and toilets stank and were just nasty. Do yourself a favour and steer well clear of Azzurro Hotel. The place is a joke.

positive_text: Honestly, not much this time. I've stayed here before and it was acceptable at the time, hence why I decided to give it a second chance. But after my second stay, I can definitely say never again.
negative_text: The idea of a hostel with staff working offsite is such a stupid idea. Issues don't get resolved as they don’t respond to messages and they take no accountability. The locks are a joke at both entrance to hostel and room. Terribly designed and rarely work. When you first enter the hostel, there's around 50-100 left bags of luggage just haphazardly dumped throughout the hostel foyer. Massive safety issue. Especially when power isn't working; which was the case when I arrived. They enforce you to fill out lots of paperwork before arrival, fiat enough. But then do nothing to make sure guests are doing the right thing. In my room, had one person who had their phone speaker going for ages, ignoring other guests to turn it off. So no one got much sleep. To make matters worse, this person was leaving snotty tissues all over floor and also had a plate of food left lying in the room. Now I understand why there were so many cockroaches. But when I told staff, my messages were ignored. Bathrooms and few and far between and don't indicate if someone is already inside. So once you do finally get to shower and/or go to the toilet, be prepared for droves of other guests continously trying to turn the knob to get in. There's more but it's easier to just say go find a better hostel than this. Especially one that has staff actually in the building to help you.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Darling Harbour - Near Convention Center
review_title: I hated my stay here, do yourself a favour and book a YHA instead (the price isn't much different)
negative_text: I booked a 2 night stay and left after 1 night. 1) The photos look good and it has an overall good rating calls itself a “Pod Hotel”- do not be fooled! Price attractive includes breakfast and dinner, honestly I think you're better off booking into a lovely YHA and getting some bread or cereal yourself! My room wasn’t anything like the photos. 2) No staff at reception, communicate though a monitor screen. The luggage storage is an open room, not secure at all. Communal areas were smelly and dirty. 4) Location inconvenient getting to and from the hostel and quite a sketchy area 6) I had a 4 bed dorm to myself as no one else had booked but it was SO depressing in there. The room smelt of damp and it looked like there was mould on the curtains . I woke up with a chesty cough (also cold in there) 7) The aircon was in the room set to 23 degrees, I asked staff at around 9pm and they said there should be a remote in the room, there wasn’t so they said they’ll send someone. They 2 hours later (around 11pm) and I asked them to switch airon off he refused saying it would get too hot. It was Autumn. He said to call if too cold, so I did they said someone will come. They came just before 1AM to switch it off. I was sleeping. 8) I did not want to stay another night so I left in the morning and was refused a refund for the night I wasn’t staying. I gave numerous opportunities to resolve this but I think it’s important to leave an honest review. I’ve stayed in many hostels internationally and I will take bad reviews with a pinch of salt if photos and rating seems good, but I think this is the worst I’ve stayed in. The photos are very misleading, it looks nice on the photos but the reality is far from it. The vibe in terms of décor, smell, cleanliness and even other people there is SO depressing. I was so much happier when I went to a YHA instead. 9) Bathrooms are small, so get soaked and gross and not enough of them. Limited characters so had to cut text out.The end.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Darling Harbour - Near Convention Center
review_title: Very disappointing. Not as nice as it's made out to be.
positive_text: The food provided was fine. Simple breakfast of cheap cereal with milk, white bread for toast with either jam or peanut butter, and tea/coffee/juice. Dinner was pretty basic, like being on a school camp. Plenty of food to fill you up, but lacking in quality and nutrition. The bed was reasonably comfortable, but a challenge getting into the top bunk.
negative_text: Not very good. Surprised at the overall quite high ratings. The pictures were clearly taken when renovations were new and everything was crisp and nice. Now it's generally pretty run down and grotty. Everything's a little bit dirty, especially the bathrooms which definitely need a deep clean. Also some of the bathrooms have issues like broken showers. There is minimal storage options in the bedroom, some hooks and more/bigger cupboards would've been nice. The bunk bed itself was nice enough to sleep in but limited beside fixtures (ie no shelf or fixed light) make it less than ideal. Reception is entirely remote. The online check-in wasn't working when I arrived and was left waiting for someone to respond to my messages. Especially difficult when you've just arrived in the country and don't have proper phone/internet access yet. Also the need to upload signed pdf forms and ID to stay after payment and confirmation has come through its a nuisance. All in all I felt like I'd walked into a poor house rather than a "hotel" as they call themselves. I understand it is cheap accommodation but don't get your hopes up. I was definitely disappointed and won't be staying here again except as a last resort.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Darling Harbour - Near Convention Center
review_title: Great location and comfortable. Awesome for the price.
positive_text: Check-in was easy. The beds were comfortable, and the bathrooms were never crowded. The rooms were quiet, nice and dark. The cleaning team did a good job, given that it is a busy hostel. But keep in mind that you will be sharing with a lot of people, so know what to expect. Breakfast was good. They offered cereals, milk, coffee, juice, bread, spreads, and jams. You could keep your things in the fridge and have full access to the kitchen to prepare whatever else you wanted. Was great to come home to a warm meal, as dinner is included in the package. The staff was always super nice. Great location.
negative_text: At the first day, getting there was difficult on foot. Coming from the Central Station, it is easy to get lost even using Google Maps because the Harbour has many bridges and stairs. Maybe they should advise people to use public transportation on the first day or have a better map of the area with clear instructions on how to navigate those bridges if you are trying to walk to the place coming from the Central Station. I walked by myself at 11 PM. I did not feel unsafe at all, but what was supposed to be a 20-minute walk turned into a 40-minute walk because I kept getting lost so I had to stop and ask around. The furniture and carpets are not that new anymore (as the pictures show).

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Darling Harbour - Near Convention Center
review_title: cheap place to sleep, spend your awake time somewhere else
positive_text: It is a very cheap option to have a place to sleep in Sydney and the location is near a tram station, so if you're not keen on good bathrooms or otherwise pleasant amenities, then go for it. The beds have curtains and you have some kind of privacy. Bring earplugs and a sleepmask anyway. Be prepared to spend all your waking hours some other place, though.
negative_text: Breakfast is literally only white toast, jam and peanut butter, as well as cereal and milk. The dinner could have been prison food ( I got the vegetarian option). I guess it's free - yay? The property is run-down, not very clean, the bathrooms only have those rain-shower heads with poor water pressure, so washing long hair is a pain. My room smelled bad, and I think a lot of the people staying there are not actually travellers but people who make a living with Uber Eats, because the big Uber Eats backpacks were everywhere, in the rooms, and also clogging up space in the very tiny luggage room. Stairs are crooked, the carpet needs some deep cleaning, check-in is done via a qr-code (there is no actual reception, just a little monitor with someone remote - I am not kidding). They did not have any extra blankets available, so I was very cold at night.

Could do with some social activities, its quite isolating.

positive_text: The bed was comfy and had a curtain and reading light
negative_text: A very peculiar place. Not manned and as a female solo traveller in her 20s I personally didn’t feel safe. I think that was heightened as well by the fact that I had booked a 4bed dorm and was only me in there and someone came in about 10-11pm , seemed to settle down then around 1ish I thought they had an alarm go off but turns out it was someone phoning them, they had a convo and then left? Because of it not being manned it just felt like a free for all. The room was ok but everything else was just dirty and grim. The bathrooms weren’t the best and luckily I was only there for 1 night because I think I would have felt more dirty than clean if I had taken a shower there. There’s breakfast and dinner included but I did not eat there. But I was there around dinner time and there were people sat on the stairs eating and it just seemed very chaotic and nothing is explained at all. Yes it may be cheap and include the food but I have paid the same price to stay in other places minus the food where it’s at least been clean and I’ve felt safe which I would take over having the food.

positive_text: I recently had the opportunity to stay at this popular hostel, and I wanted to share my experience. In conclusion, while no place is perfect, I believe this hostel does a commendable job in creating a welcoming atmosphere. The staff’s dedication and the comfort of the beds helped make my stay enjoyable.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Darling Harbour - Near Convention Center
review_title: 2 day 2 night stay at 6 bed en-suite room
positive_text: I liked the location of the place, places that i wanted to visit was in walkable distance / accessible by public transport. I also liked that this place uses an electronic lock with a password, this eliminates the use and carrying of a physical card. Price of bed is very good value for money for short stays. I noticed that there are scheduled cleans for trash cans and bathrooms which is really good. The room is also really quiet and with the air conditioner set at a nice temperature. My roomies were all very nice and respectful which added to the whole experience :)) Communication with the front desk through the Booking.com app was very quick and convenient. Response times are pretty quick which I really appreciate! Personally did not try the dinner but breakfast was decent, having toasted bread with spreads like jam and peanut butter. It's what I would eat at home for a budget breakfast. Would be nice if there were more cheap protein options like yogurt though! All in all, for the price of this place, it truly exceeded my expectations :)
negative_text: I didnt like that the room was dusty - as someone who is easily allergic to dust, I wake up with very stuffy nose and an itchy throat. The velvet curtains picks up a lot of dust easily as well so when we close the velvet curtains for privacy, the dust ends up getting trapped inside. Maybe more scheduled vacuuming of rooms would be better! This was on me, but i didnt check that the lockers were old school lockers which required a lock, and that there were no body wash / shampoo provided. Would suggest to put all these info at an easily readable section for travellers to be informed earlier. It would be better if the main door's pin was configured correctly when the traveller first checks in. I had to reach out to ask for the main door's password in order for them to update it so that I was able to enter.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Darling Harbour - Near Convention Center
negative_text: Look, a hostel is a hostel: between the bunk beds and the shared bathrooms it’s never going to be an ideal place to stay. However, I felt bamboozled by the other reviews I read, and I just wanted to share my experience so you know what to expect: For the most part it was cleanly, but I did see a cockroach in the bathroom one day and several cockroaches right outside the building. The layout of the entire space was strange, I think we had to go on the fire escape to get to our room? And there was another room that you entered from the outside. Our door didn’t always close so I’d sometimes return to an open and unlocked door. That wasn’t a big deal but didn’t feel great in terms of security. There weren’t very many common spaces - the only common space was the dining room which wasn’t very big. Between this and the small rooms and the no talking rule in rooms, it made it hard to spend time in the hostel. As a result there were often people sitting in stairwells, which sometimes was inconvenient to walk around. there isn’t any elevator in the space, so when I arrived and left I had to carry my bags up several flights of thin stairs There were lots or rules and fines. Every day I would get a message about a new rule in the hostel and and the fine we would receive if we violated it. For example, we weren’t allowed to hang towels on bars of beds, but we also weren’t provided hooks to hang towels elsewhere. There seemed to be a lot of surveillance, but I also never saw anyone at the front desk, including both when I checked in and when I checked out. When you first arrive you have to upload a picture of your passport or else you get locked out. I did that and it was working fine, and then a few hours later it randomly locked me out. I was able to text their off-hours number and they let me back in (their texting service was very responsive), but getting locked out of the place I’m staying for no reason is still a problem.

positive_text: The bed was comfortable and clean with power/light and blackout curtain. negative_text: It’s advertised as a Pod Hotel but it is neither, it’s a hostel with bunkbeds not pods. Bathrooms not always clean which I appreciate may be more to do with how other guests leave things rather than the cleaning. I didn’t like being sent messages repeatedly about cash in exchange for promoting the place on TikTok or Instagram. I hope any good reviews are only provided based on honest opinions not in exchange for money. There are no social events or area to socialise other than the dining room. review_title: Good value for money in a rather central location. Good for backpackers on a budget and short term
positive_text: Beds were fairly comfortable, new and clean. As a big guy a bit too short, but that's not their fault. Outlets were provided. Enough for 6 people, that's for sure. Lockers were big enough to fit a daypack though not a big backpack. All in all good value for money for a short stay. Digital keys and door locks were pretty comfortable as well. Plenty of cutlery in the kitchen. Staff seemed very kind and helpful. Toilets and toilet&showers seemed alright. Not very spacious but acceptable.
negative_text: Kitchen was barely usable for my personal standards at least. Only a few portable cooking plates which couldn't even get pasta water to boil. Many dirty spots in there too. Seems like an old pub with kitchen and hotel rooms above them has be redone. More or less at least. In the kitchen there still is the old thoroughly rusted stove which seems to not be working. Public transport is about a 20min walk away, I'd recommend using an uber.

review_title: Really worth the money and food was great
positive_text: The beds mattress was nice, the dhna was lovely and soft the privacy curtains were great and velvet same as the duna absolutely fantastic. The ensuite bathroom was convenient. I was on the ground floor right next to the front door and didn't have to lug my luggage up the stairs. The location is perfect. The food was good. I really loved the breakfast and dinner that was provided. That especially made it stand out from venus' other hostels. Especially their Potts point hostel in comparison to this one potts point was not great. But this hostel got most things right. The price was great, the quiet policies were upheld, the bathroom worked well and wasn't missing bits. The bedding was lovely, the curtains were fantastic and the doona oh my god that doona was soft and lovely. Dinner was wonderful I made friends there. Breakfast was quiet. The lockers were nice although they are missing an opportunity by not adding lockable drawers like taquila sunrise hostel has under the beds that would increase luggage storage space. They have lots of food pantry storage for each room. The set up is pretty good. They had wifi which was good. They have luggage storage which was fantastic and they even sent me a list of places to go and things tonsee and do in the area which was fantastic with great detail on it. The hostel was quiet and I was able to sleep during the day and night. The other guests were respectful and friendly.
negative_text: There should be a handle on the top or side of the top bunk because its difficult getting in and out of it. They should send you check-in information the day before not the day of your booking and only just before you're supposed to arrive. The goki app is great and worked just fine for me but having that information the day before would have significantly reduced my stress and made the process smoother and more efficient. Check-in earlier would have been really good rather than waiting outside for 3 hours. The signage on the outside of the hostel could be improved as it wasnt obvious or easy to find the hostel or the front door.

positive_text: Комната нормальная в которой жил, вид на мост Харбор и Оперу Сиднея. Расположение хорошее
negative_text: Начнем с заселения, приходит сообщение от отеля, что необходимо зарегистрироваться онлайн, но в сообщении нет никаких ссылок или QR кода для регистрации онлайн, я прилетел в Сидней и написал им в 1:30PM, с вопросом где регистрироваться онлайн, но ответа так и не поступило, хотя пишут что отвечают на сообщения в букинге и по почте своей, я решил ехать в отель. Приехал в отель в 3:00PM, на двери есть QR-код для регистрации, я зарегистрировался и перешел в приложение GOKI, но там сказано было что вы не зарегистрированы и соответственно нет никаких кодов для того, чтобы попасть в комнату и внутрь здания! В итоге я простоял на улице у двери в отель под дождем до практически 05:00PM, так как никто не отвечал на мои сообщения по почте, в букинге, в ватсап с 1:30PM! Ответили только ближе к 5 вечера, и пришлось ждать когда мне отправят коды от дверей! Причина в том, что якобы сотрудник не видел мои сообщения!!! В общем много времени потрачено впустую при онлайн заселении. По поводу хранения багажа, если вы привыкли оставлять в отеле, то это не ваш вариант, оставить можно только до полудня! И они могли бы пойти мне навстречу, с учетом того, что два часа я не мог попасть в свою комнату, но нет, мне отказали, можно только до полудня, а у меня вылет был вечером! Из-за проблем с регистрацией я не смог зарегистрироваться на ужин. По поводу чистоты, ну помойте вы уже окна в комнатах с «видом» на мост и оперу, там просто разглядеть надо все через эту грязь. В зоне кухни грязно, ремонт сделан приятный в светлых тонах, но везде грязь! Грязные раковины, зона готовки, в раковине еда, посуда не мытая! В общем сначала хотел забронировать еще на 6 ночей через неделю, но это того не стоит, поэтому передумал.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
review_title: BAD - but year before not bad bunk beds that dont move, cheap ad cheerful good location
room_type: Mixed Pod 4 Beds Room with Sydney Harbour Bridge View
positive_text: I had stayed at this property several times last year, and while the customer service wasn’t always outstanding, I understood it’s a hostel environment. However, during one stay, I was placed right next to a bathroom, and there was constant door slamming throughout the night (2–4am). Understandably, I was frustrated and contacted reception via the intercom. Unfortunately, I was told there were no options to move rooms and that I would just have to put up with it. The following morning, the manager informed me that I was no longer welcome, despite having stayed there for nearly two months the previous year and across multiple locations. I found this response extreme and unjustified. When I tried to discuss the situation, the manager was combative, dismissive, and ultimately hung up on me, stating he didn’t care and that I was effectively evicted. I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion. I want to highlight that Lia, a staff member, consistently provided excellent customer service—professional, helpful, and respectful at all times. Months later, when I returned to Sydney, I even apologized in an attempt to stay again, though I’m not sure why I felt the need to. My reservation was declined regardless. Overall, the situation felt disproportionate and poorly handled. I was left confused, as the outcome didn’t seem to match the circumstances.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
review_title: Not as advertised and poorly maintained.
negative_text: Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations. There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion. Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided. On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag. There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates. Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning. There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

positive_text: The location was good, not far from the cbd
negative_text: I don’t usually write a reviews but this place deserves one. The staff are like robots, not helpful at all. They just repeat the same sentences all the time. I arrived at 10am, they canceled my flight and it took me whole night and 3 flights to get to Sydney. I slept 1 hour. I asked the receptionist if it’s possible to check in earlier and even was ready to pay for it. She said no. I asked if she could at least ask housekeeper to do my bed first, she didn’t want to help me at all. She said the check in time is 3pm. I asked at 2:45 if my room is ready and she said that the bed is ready but the room is not cleaned yet and I have to wait till 3pm. The room at 3pm was completely dirty. She was clearly lying to me all the time and the bed was done long before. There was trash on the floor and hairs in the sink. It was disgusting. The other bathroom in the hostel was also very dirty. The receptionist works online and have no idea what the housekeepers are doing, or not doing and she is not willing to help guests at all. I saw her asking someone is that person works there, how she can not know that? Also the day I was checking out, the other receptionist told me I can store my backpack till 2pm and when I asked if I can pick it up at 3pm she just repeated the same sentence. Didn’t even say that sorry it’s not possible or anything, just was repeating the same sentence as a robot. Like why I can store my backpack only till 2pm? The hostel costs 75$ a night, I should be about to at least leave my bag there when I wait for my flight. It’s ridiculous. Also to rent a towel is $15. You can definitely find a better place in this price with nice and helpful staff. There are many different hostels on this street.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: Ingenting.
negative_text: När vi kom till rummet var det ett HELT ANNAT rum än det som var på Booking. Det var otroligt mörkt, smutsigt och extremt slitet. AC:n var portabel och lät extremt mycket samtidigt som det gick en stor slang ut ur fönstret som var öppet. Det var slarvigt tejpat så fönstret hade fortfarande ett öppet hål längst ner. Detta bjöd in rök lukt från de som stod och rökte utanför entrén samt kackerlackor. Badrummen var otroligt smutsiga och det var svartmögel vart man än titta. Vi insåg direkt att vi hade blivit scammade och tog kontakt med ”receptionen” som var en person i en IPad i hallen. Det sa att det skulle titta på rummet vilket det gjorde, personalen som kolla sa att vi hade fått fel rum och att han höll med om att det absolut inte var samma rum. De sa att vi kunde byta till det rätta rummet dagen efter men INTE få återbetalt för natten i det hemska rummet vi hade. De sa även att det inte var återbetalningsbart trots att det inte appliceras i fall där kunden har blivit SCAMMAD. Till slut går det med på att återbetala om vi lämnar SAMMA KVÄLL, klockan var 20:00 och det var otroligt påfrestande. Vi fråga om det gick bra att byta till det rätta rummet morgonen efter då vi inte kunde hitta boende. ”Kundtjänst” sa då följande: Ni har fått rätt rum, alla de privata rummet ser ut så, bilderna på Booking är bara ”refrensbilder” - trots att de hade sagt att vi fick fel rum? Vi fick tag på Booking som hjälpte oss att få full återbetalning och vi lämnade samma kväll. Kort sagt, rummen ser inte ALLS ut som de gör på bilderna och jag avråder samtliga personer från att bo här.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: I did not like anything
negative_text: This is by far the worst hostel I’ve ever stayed at in my life! Dirty, smelly… the room stank so bad I could barely sleep. There’s only one women’s bathroom with 2 toilets and 2 showers—for the entire hostel! No security, no privacy. The kitchen was disgusting: dirty pots, plates, cups, everything! People leave a mess and there’s nobody to clean it up. There’s no reception—just one person online talking to you through a camera and a computer screen. The ad claims the rooms have air conditioning—total lie! The room is hot, the bed is terrible. There’s not a single common area. Just a filthy kitchen with a table and chairs, and some weird cubicle with benches. So forget trying to arrive early, relax, charge your phone, hang out, or meet anyone—impossible! Rotten place. I would never go back, I’d rather sleep in the subway. I paid way too much because they lie in their ads, while there are so many better, cheaper hostels with friendly, attentive staff. I already know hostel service in Australia can be poor, but this place took mediocrity to a whole new level. My advice? Don’t stay here—unless you want to punish yourself, or hope they either go out of business or actually improve. Total trash.

review_title: If you have low expectations, make them lower. Not very well taken care of. Beds are great
positive_text: Beds are great.My 6 beds room was big. However the floor shakes when someone walks around but definitely the most comfortable bed I've slept on in a hostel
negative_text: The kitchen is full of fruit flies, the bathrooms are constantly wet, (but pressure and water temperature are good) kitchenware is poorly washed and the place is older and beaten up compared to what is shown on booking. Only 1 bathroom per floor in my building and some nights I had to go in the building next door (part of the hostel) to use the toilet. At checkout, I was out of the room early, but I had a few trips up and down the stairs to take my suitcase and backpacks and they changed the code to gate and room and it was a struggle to get my stuff. Just give a 20 minutes window?! We are leaving, Jezzzz. Food seems to be like a little buffet from the pictures but it isn't. I do not recommend it if you have allergies, it doesn't seem like the place who would be able to respect cross contamination and so on. Also with the condition of the kitchen, I didn't feel like eating there either. Bring some good earplugs cause the AC will scream if turned on. There's no in person receptionist, just remotely through the screen. If you're on a budget, it's fine, it's also close to the metro and it's easy to get there from the airport.

La zona in cui si trova é comoda come posizione rispetto al centro e alle attrazioni principali ma la via in sé non è proprio raccomandabile. Non fatevi ingannare dalle foto, anche per quanto riguarda la mezza pensione, tanto vale andare altrove e cucinare per conto vostro, e magari non mangiare in corridoio come ho dovuto fare io.

review_title: Nie wieder werde ich diese Unterkunft buchen!
positive_text: Die Lage war gut.
negative_text: Der Check-in erfolgt nicht persönlich, sondern über eine Rezeptionistin per Video. Der uns mitgeteilte Code für die Zimmertür funktionierte nicht, auch der zweite Code ermöglichte keinen Zugang zum Zimmer. Der Hausmeister öffnete uns nach einiger Zeit die Tür, wir konnten das Zimmer aber nicht mehr verlassen, da der Code nicht funktionierte. Ein weiterer Gast, welchen ich um Hilfe bat, sagte aus, dass auch sein Zimmercode nicht funktioniere und er deshalb ständig einen Schuh in die Zimmertür stellen musste, damit ihm der Eintritt jederzeit möglich war. Zudem wurden wir um 21.30 Uhr von einem Angestellten aufgefordert, die Zimmertür zu öffnen, denn er wollte an der Decke einen Rauchmelder installieren. Er erklärte es sei ein Notfall, wir hörten die Bohrmaschine aus den Nebenzimmern. Erst nach mehrmaligem intensiven Verneinen unsererseits entfernte sich der Angestellte und ließ uns schlussendlich in Ruhe. Das Zimmer war extrem klein (2x3m)und man konnte sich kaum umdrehen, da die Koffer auf dem Boden ausgepackt werden mussten. Der Preis war meiner Meinung nicht gerechtfertigt, es fehlte auch die Sauberkeit und ein einfacher angemessener Komfort.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
review_title: Nice hostel, but poor food, and no on-site staff.
room_type: Mixed Pod 4 Beds Room with Sydney Harbour Bridge View
positive_text: Positives : - 3 mins walk to Kings Cross station - cooking facilities available. - laundry was $4AUD for wash and the same for the drier.
negative_text: Negatives : - no staff on site - all comms are online, or via a video call on a monitor at the entrance - dinner is awful. Truly bad. We got mash and an under-cooked chicken one night. I had to buy a curry from a Thai restaurant opposite, cos I couldn't risk eating the chicken. - Breakfast is very basic. Cereals, toast and jam. It's meant to be served at 7:30am, but one day it didn't become available till 7:50 - an issue for me cos I had to rush to the airport to catch my flight. - The comms keep saying that dinner is from 6:30pm onwards, but it's NOT. It's not available until 7:30pm. This inconvenienced myself and two other guests, as we had all come back to the hostel for 6:30pm to be fed. A simple change in the Wattsapp message is not much effort for the hotel management to make. - there are cameras everywhere and signs everywhere saying "Smoking.....alcohol....$500 fine", "Not cleaning your dishes....$100 fine" etc etc. You feel like a person in a Big Brother House being watched at all times. Tip : stay in the Harbour View room - it's facing away from the street so you won't hear any noise.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: Dobrá lokalita v docházkové vzdálenosti do centra města.
negative_text: Lokalita je sice v blízkosti centra, ale k ubytování vedou dlouhé schody, takže lidé s kufry by měli raději přijet autem. Přijela jsem a neměla ani data ani wifi a ke vstupu do ubytování byl potřeba online check-in zvenku dveří. Naštěstí mě někdo pustil dovnitř a připojila jsem se na wifi a dokončila check-in uvnitř (předtím mi žádné takové informace nepřišly). V ubytování je na pokojích málo místa pro zavazadla a zdálo se, že řada osob zde i bydlí trvale (slečna ve stejném pokoji jako já, nebo muž, který pracoval pro roznáškovou službu na jídlo a pak si suverénně do ubytování odemkl a šel na pokoj). Byla jsem z ubytování trochu zklamaná, hlavně z check-inu, prvního dojmu v nehezké vstupní hale a pak ze slečny u nás na pokoji, která byla nemocná a 24/7 spala, chrápala nebo kašlala (to ale chápu, že se nedá ovlivnit a patří to k hostelu). Zásuvky byly všechny již zabrané, ale stačilo jen odpojit lampičku v posteli a do toho si dát vlastní nabíječku.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: The location is excellent—just a few minutes’ walk from Kings Cross Station, and within walking distance to the Royal Botanic Gardens, the Art Gallery of NSW, the State Library, and even the Sydney Opera House, all under 30 minutes away. The included dinner is a nice bonus and much appreciated. However, during my 6-night stay, the menu was quite repetitive (two nights of pasta and four nights of biryani). A bit more variety would definitely improve the experience. The area feels safe, and the location alone makes this place a convenient base for exploring Sydney. With a few adjustments, especially around dining options and room amenities, this could be an even better stay.
negative_text: The hostel does not have a lift, and the hallways are very narrow, which makes moving around with luggage a bit difficult. The shower/toilet and common areas also feel quite cramped. At night, when the kitchen is closed, the only available common space is very small, so it may not be ideal for those who need to do remote work while traveling. Another small inconvenience is that there are no hooks in the rooms for towels or other items.

Enfim... é sujo, lotado, barulhento e mal organizado.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: I loved staying at Azzurro. The location is one of the best in the whole city, it has a beautiful view of the Opera House and it's close to a lot of useful establishments for students and backpackers, such as the Kings Cross library, the Kings Cross train station, supermarkets, grocery stores, washing house, pubs, restaurants and more. The hostel fulfills the proposal of being a non party hostel. Despite that, this is the perfect place to be surrounded by people from several countries and it's very easy to make friends, people are very kind and friendly. The beds are very comfortable, mostly because of the bedding set and the curtains they have in it. The staff is great, they are friendly and whatever you need they will help.
negative_text: The common areas are not very clean, especially the tables, and there's not much space to put your supermarket things in the storerooms or in the fridges, so try not to buy a lot of things!!! The hostel is not responsible for your belongings, so keep a careful eye to your belongings, mostly small things, for example, jewelery or your umbrella, because people will steal it. I'm not saying this is a characteristic of this hostel. It could happen anywhere, but be careful. The food could be better and have more meal variations, but, at least, they are very generous about it, so it's impossible to starve.

positive_text: The people I met were lovely and was sad to end my stay early for that.
negative_text: Honestly, I never thought I'd write a bad review but I'm quite disappointed at this point. I was given a room in the basement which was fine but it was quite stuffy and it smelt very damp. They gave me a new room but I had to pay an upgrade. The new room was a bit better but still smelt. There wasn't any staff, just a virtual receptionist which is fine but makes it a little harder to speak to someone. Most people there seem to be inbetween jobs/working which is also fine but not the vibe I was looking for (everyone I met was lovely though). By this point I was tempted to leave. The last thing that made me leave was when I pulled the curtain in my bed to get out, it fell and hit my face. It hurt! I spoke to them over WhatsApp and they were very apologetic. However, no one got back to me about a resolution and to be honest I never expect a refund or anything but was quite fed up by this point and just disappointed no one got back to me even after reminding them. I hate writing bad reviews and understand hostels are hostels but I do expect the basics to be decent at least. I waited a while before writing this but I needed to be honest.

review_title: Upon re-reading reviews, the good ones are forged - do not stay here if you can afford something else
positive_text: Not much, it was cheap and there’s a reason for it
negative_text: Do not stay here if you can afford something else, it’s not worth it. Upon arriving there is no staff physically at the property which I found strange only someone on an iPad. The room smelt bad as something had spilt on the floor so I changed rooms, the next room had people who brought others in the room who weren’t staying there and spoke until gone 12am, not to mention his 5 mobile phones lying around… The bathrooms were always dirty and soaking wet as the shower was in the toilet. The door didn’t lock unless you pulled it and the front door was always wedged open so security was non existent and I didn’t feel safe staying there. If you were lucky to get a charging plug on top bunk, they were multiple extension leads together which looked very dangerous to me. The dinner was very bland and I didn’t bother after my chicken looked very grey. Overall I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone I know to stay and certainly wouldn’t return myself.

The food is questionable - sometimes you get decent pasta pomodoro, and other times it’s an inedible Indian-style dish of some kind. Breakfast is okay if you bring your own cheese and ham, as the only options provided are peanut butter, jam and cereal which aren’t really enough. Overall, the view is fabulous, and the price for what you get is fair. This place seems like a decent option for a short stay of a few nights - but definitely not more

review_title: Mostly great deal. We get what we pay for
positive_text: Honestly, it was a fine place to lay the head for a few nights. Sheets were soft, lamps were fitted into the mostly clean bunks (stray hair here and there, nbd), privacy curtains and sinks in each dorm, which was nice, since the bathrooms had one sink per. Staff was nice enough, and they were able to help book an extra night seamlessly, albeit remotely. I didn't shower at this hostel, mind you. Beds were actually really comfy.
negative_text: I didn't like that there was a giant sign on the front door that said to keep closed at all times, yet every time I came back, whether it be 6 pm or 11 pm, the door was wide open. Seamed like the people staying there more long term just didn't really respect the place, or the other people in it, which also showed by the way people kept their areas in the dorms. My last night (the extra one), a woman who I believe may have been staying there long term, was tweaking in the doorway with the door wide open. No one on staff was trying to help her, and a bunch of yelling commenced for maybe 30-45 minutes after I got to bed shortly after. Really had no issues up until the last night. Overall, the building does have a strange energy.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: The included breakfast and optional dinner are definitely highlights – breakfast is simple but sufficient, and the pre-order dinner is a convenient way to ensure a proper meal. The dinner I had was actually very good, and it’s a great benefit to have this option directly at the hostel. The location is a plus – like most hostels around King’s Cross, there’s a terrace with a nice view of the Harbour Bridge. That said, the overall experience might be more pleasant in warmer seasons.
negative_text: However, one evening I asked for seconds, and the main cook told us to come back in 20 minutes. I waited over 30 minutes, and each time I approached, he just said “wait, wait” and served others instead. Eventually, there was nothing left, and I had to go out and buy food elsewhere – which felt like a big minus. The room I stayed in was in the basement, quite cold and not very well insulated. I can’t imagine staying there during winter. The room was spacious, but everything creaked, and there was no power outlet for the upper bunk. Also, the place felt dimly lit, which made it hard to find at first. The hostel operates in two separate buildings, but it’s not clear where you’re staying. After booking on Booking.com, you still need to register on the hostel’s website and then check in again at reception – which is unnecessarily complicated. There is no larger lounge area in the accommodation where you can work or relax. Only an extended version of the dining room, which was always dirty, at least during my stay. Overall, a fair option for travelers on a budget – especially during warmer days – but be prepared for some practical discomforts.

Also, the place felt dimly lit, which made it hard to find at first. The hostel operates in two separate buildings, but it’s not clear where you’re staying. After booking on Booking.com, you still need to register on the hostel’s website and then check in again at reception – which is unnecessarily complicated. There is no larger lounge area in the accommodation where you can work or relax. Only an extended version of the dining room, which was always dirty, at least during my stay. Overall, a fair option for travelers on a budget – especially during warmer days – but be prepared for some practical discomforts.

positive_text: I stayed here for just one night during a quick trip to Sydney to catch up with a friend, and honestly, I was really impressed by how smooth and comfortable everything was, even in such a short stay. The check-in process was fully online, and while there wasn’t anyone at a physical front desk, the staff were super responsive through chat and email. I had a couple of small questions before arrival, and they replied within minutes. All the instructions were clear, and I had no issues getting in — key codes and access were all sent in advance. The location is absolutely perfect — just a few minutes walk from a supermarket, and loads of cute cafes, takeaway places, and late-night food nearby. I even found a great bubble tea nearby! Even though I only stayed one night, I could tell this place is very thoughtfully set up for travelers — especially solo travelers like me. The room was quiet, clean, and the bed was actually really comfortable, with privacy curtains on each bed, personal charging ports, and lockers. I also loved the rooftop terrace — even in a short stay, I managed to catch the sunset there. It's a beautiful space. The Wi-Fi was strong and reliable, even in the room.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: Location was really good and we enjoyed the inclusion of food but these were the only good things about this property. Vastly different from the photos, it felt like staying in a crackden, our twin room was outside in what reminded me of a prison room. The front door was left open at all times during the day which meant anyone could’ve walked in or out and with no staff actually on site (you can see someone on an iPad near the door) if someone had walked in that shouldn’t be there, there was literally no one to stop them. The kitchen/dining areas were consistently gross and I’m glad breakfast and dinner were provided as I wouldn’t want to cook in them. The food for breakfast and dinner was good, although you have to book for dinner. On our first night we booked via the link given to us after I did our online check in however we weren’t on the list. The staff member serving food was really rude to us but I argued it and showed them the booking and we ended up being given tiny portions. On another day I saw them turn a girl away who had probably done the same thing! The outside chill out area is actually nice and has a good view of the harbour and the opera house. The location was really good, Potts Point itself is lovely and the walk from the hostel through the botanic gardens towards the main area was great. The place overall has a very unfriendly vibe, there’s signs everywhere saying there’s cameras and if they see people stealing they will call the police. This was no joke as in one tiny dining room there were 6 cameras!! There’s also signs everywhere saying no talking/phone calling in the rooms. I understand completely about being respectful but this was extreme as it said anyone reported to be talking in the rooms would be ejected. Overall it did our budget some good but I wouldn’t stay again. In our 7 months of (worldwide) travelling probably our least favourite place!

review_title: I’d definitely consider staying here again, even for leisure. Highly recommend!
positive_text: I stayed at Potts Point for just one night as part of a longer business trip across Australia, and I was genuinely impressed by how comfortable and convenient the experience was. The location is truly ideal—quiet and charming, yet still close to the action. It's just a short walk to the Town Hall station, which made getting around the city incredibly easy. I even managed to squeeze in a quick visit to Bondi Beach, which was only a few rides away—perfect for unwinding after a full day of meetings. The hostel itself is well-designed and thoughtfully maintained. The backyard and dining area stood out to me as peaceful spots where you could relax, grab a cup of coffee, or get some work done if needed. It was clear that the staff take pride in keeping the place clean and organized—my private room was spotless, and the shared areas were tidy and welcoming. Special mention goes to the receptionist, who was not only polite and professional but also very efficient. After a long day of travel and work, I appreciated how quick and smooth the check-in process was. They also gave great recommendations for nearby places to eat and how to get around easily. All in all, Potts Point Hostel exceeded my expectations, especially for a short business stop. It’s a great blend of comfort, cleanliness, and location, with a touch of character that makes you feel more at home than in a typical hotel.

positive_text: Preis-Leistung passt. Betten sind bequem und mit Vorhängen ausgestattet. Unter das Bett passt problemlos der Rucksack und es gibt einen Spind, der mit eigenem Schloss verschließbar ist. Frühstück ist zwar einfach, aber ausreichend: Kaffee, Tee, Toast, Margarine, Marmelade, Müsli.. Abendessen ist okay, aber nicht sehr abwechslungsreich (2 Tage Reis mit Salat und Hähnchenfleisch und 1 Tag Nudeln mit Tomatensoße). Gemeinschaftsduschen relativ eng geschnitten, was das Anziehen etwas schwierig macht Im Zimmer wenig Möglichkeiten Kleidung oder Badetücher aufzuhängen. Badetücher nur gegen Gebühr erhältlich. Einchecken ist online möglich. Etwas versteckt auf der Webseite findet man Infos zu einer App, über die die Türen geöffnet werden können und das Abendessen gebucht werden kann. Lage ist gut. In ca. 20 Minuten ist man zu Fuß im Stadtzentrum. Ca. 5 Minuten entfernt ist eine Metrostation.

Alternativ muss man das Nebenhaus verlassen, auf die Straße gehen und dann zum Haupthaus nebenan laufen. Das inklusive Abendessen empfand ich als eintönig: Es bestand fast täglich aus Reis, etwas Salat (auch immer gleich) und dann alternativ Fleisch/vegetarisches Schnitzel. Kurzum: Da ist noch deutlich Luft nach oben.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
positive_text: Only positives were that the bed had blackout curtains, and there were lockers. The company was pretty responsive on the chat function.
negative_text: I’m not really sure how this place gets an It was crowded, not nearly enough social areas or showers/toilets for the amount of people staying there. There were clearly quite a few people staying in the hostel longer term and there were peoples personal belongings all over the room, so it felt messy. There were extension cables daisy chained across the room to provide power to the beds which is a massive fire hazard. I counted 6 extensions connected to one wall outlet (it’s an old building so there is clearly a shortage of sockets) The beds were really creaky so you couldn’t move without disturbing others. Pillows need replacing as well as they were very lumpy. Breakfast was ok, basic (toast and cereal, instant coffee/tea) also finishes at 9 which is quite early. The free dinner was again basic but tasted pretty good (chicken and rice). The table area is so small though that people were sat in the corridor to eat because there was no space. Views of the bridge are good from the female bathroom and maybe one or two of the rooms, the fences are too high in the outdoor area to actually see it though. Biggest annoyance was that there were no staff at the hostel itself, so when you checked in you had to download an app just to be able to get into your room. The doors seem to just be always open and people wander in and out. I had to help a group of older folks check in because they couldn’t work the passcode for the door and there was nobody else to help them. There are cleaners around sometimes but I don’t think they are directly employed by the property. They also start hoovering at 8am which can be heard all over the building so good luck if you want a lie in. As I’m backpacking I was looking for a budget option as the options are limited and everywhere is so expensive, but it’s worth paying just a little bit more for much better hostels in Sydney.

positive_text: The twin dorm room had a lot of space, lockers and a sink. You can pay with your card for the washer and dryer and also dry your clothes outside. The free breakfast is ok (toast, coffee, cereal).
negative_text: General: There is no permanent staff working there just backpackers that are being severly micro managed and cannot make any decisions without checking in with management. There were lots of useful rules posted everywhere but nobody was there to enforce them (e.g. no talking in the halls/outside people's rooms, no drinking, no smoking) Room: The room was hot, the window could not be opened and we had to run the little mobile aircon all the time which created a lot of noise. The bunk bed was an old metal bed that made noise ever time you moved. Kitchen/Food: We were assured that there would be a vegetarian option for the free dinner but in reality that usually ment you got rice and salad and no meat. That is not a balanced meal. The bathrooms were never properly cleaned, there was dirt and hair in the corners. The outside areas were also rarely or never taken care of. The dryer had a big layer of lint and dust behind the back filter which looked like a huge fire hazard. No (inside) common area apart from the table in the kitchen and a bunch of chairs in the hallway.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
negative_text: I stayed there in September 2024. Blunt knifes in the kitchen, locked windows (poor natural air ventilation), too small shower facilities, not enough showers for all people, some shower cabins had no locks on the doors, laundry/washing up liquid is not provided (need to buy your own), only one washing machine and one dryer, so there are queues to access these; only one common room to eat so not enough for all people from the two linked houses (that the hostel occupies) at the dinner time, some have to eat while sitting on the stairs, the management brought 10-20 extra chairs, but there is no space for all of them anyway (what were they thinking?). Outside, at the back of the house - the sun shade is broken, and the overall condition of the 'garden' is very poor, run down. Tea is not provided. The food that they serve for dinners (at 7-8pm) and breakfast is really not worth it - better buy your own at the local supermarket a few minutes walk away. Some rooms have enough space for tables and chairs, but these are not provided, so if you are on the top bank bed - you'll have nowhere to rest/sit down in the room. They were quite strict with the smokers and noise level and have strict no talking on the phone in the rooms policy, which was good (not sure whether any of the smokers were fined though). The washing up sponges were not changed often enough, and they didn't want to change them when were asked. Liquid soap was watered down 80x20 water to soap. Also they charge you 3.5% credit card fees irrespective of the card you were using to pay. As per the Australian payment regulation for Visa and Mastercard it should be between 0.5-1% for debit/prepaid cards, and 1-1.5% for credit cards. So, they are breaking the law. Overall feeling is very poor. Other people that stayed there at the time were also commenting that it was the worst hostel they stayed in. Not surprisingly.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
review_title: Do not stay here if you expect the bare minimum of service
negative_text: FYI/TLDR - good reviews are forged. Do not stay here if you expect the bare minimum of service. Serious failings in the staffing/management. The room + black out curtains on bed + sink/storage area - WiFi nonexistent - very small for 4 people - no aircon so windows open all night -> so many mosquitos Service No positives here, basically nonexistent service. The check in is ‘remote’ so you never actually talk to someone face to face. None of the staff wear uniform so it is not clear who is a worker. The reception is almost never manned and the French(?) guy that is sometimes there has a condescending/non-professional attitude. Hostel offers free food but it became a joke how slow it would take to serve (due to constant admin issues/slow pace of servers). We’re talking 30 mins + waiting for bland rice and bony chicken every night. The breakfast I gave up on after the second day - very cheap bread and cereal the only option. A serious issue came up re €100s of dollars worth of my clothes going missing and it was not treated with any urgency - I ended up having to solve the problem myself (I put my clothes in an empty washer and came down with them locked in the dryer, then taken to someone’s room on completion). As far as I am aware nothing was said to this guest and he blamed me for his own mixup. I came back to my room one day with everything in the previously mentioned storage/sink area thrown on the floor in a pile. The next day the staff came in the room to tell us to tidy the room??? The mess was made by the staff with no explanation. His response? “I’m one of the good guys” then proceeds to take photos of our belongings. Food service/cleaners look overworked and mentioned several times their pay is very low (I actually think below minimum wage). Unusually, no staff living onsite so at night any issue takes over an hour for someone to travel to the site to resolve (e.g. loud noises from the terrace area at 1am).

positive_text: Only the price.. but to get little more service to make it more pleasant, I would be fine also to pay more.
negative_text: Breakfast was very poor... only toast and same cereal every morning. Nothing else. Dinner was mostly Rice and chicken, and it was served, so you do not take your own dish. It's understandable cause some would take only chicken so it would not be enough for everyone. But food was just loaded to your plate, so it did not look delicious to eat. No drinks at dinner. The shower had mould on the walls and floor. And did not have hand towel or paper to dry hands at all.. toilet lock was broken. I got caught and lost my voice after the first day because of the problem with mold. This has happened to me before when i had to live in a place with the same issues.. There were no common spaces to hang out than kitchen what was too small for the guest. Sometimes, if most customers come to eat at the same time, you need to stand while eating. There is a rule that no talking in the room, so literally no one talked to me during my stay even tho I tried to make friends with my roommates.. I was ready to leave this place until I met another person from my country who convinced me to stay. Thank god I met her.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
room_type: Mixed Pod 4 Beds Room with Sydney Harbour Bridge View
negative_text: I strongly advise against staying at this hostel. My experience was unacceptable and deeply unsettling. Initially, they pressured me to book directly with them rather than through Booking.com, likely to dodge platform fees. When I chose to use Booking.com for its Afterpay option, they reacted poorly. On my final day, I was abruptly forced to leave midday without a valid explanation and denied a refund. To make matters worse, they called the police to remove my belongings, leaving them on the street, so now I’m left stranded with nowhere to stay. Their justification was that my e-bike battery supposedly violated their rules, which was untrue—I never brought it inside. When I asked to check the security cameras, they shifted to a new excuse, claiming it was about my luggage. I had already removed my luggage from their storage as instructed. Initially, they designated the room as luggage storage, but then changed their stance, calling it their office and demanding extra fees for external storage. They even posted a sign labeling it as a luggage room but later discarded my belongings. The staff, particularly one named Lizza, was incredibly rude and seemed to enjoy threatening me. I was denied the chance to complete an important exam, which caused me to fail—a devastating setback as an international student. Their treatment was unnecessarily harsh, and I wouldn’t want anyone to go through this. This hostel not only treated me disrespectfully but also took $74 for a night I didn’t stay, showing no remorse. There are much better options nearby, like Mad Monkey Hostel. Save yourself the trouble and avoid this place entirely. They may respond to this review with a polite, dismissive reply, but don’t be deceived—this reflects their true nature.

positive_text: Location
negative_text: Where do I start? The WORST hostel I've ever been. On my arrival day on October 25th, after back-of-clock international flight, I finally checked in at 2 P.M (be mindful they STRICTLY only allow check in at 2 P.M and would NEVER accommodate early check in). After one hour staying in the room, suddenly there were two technician came to fix the sink. It was so LOUD, I messaged the Venus Group Whatsapp number and they told me I was lying cause their cleaner said there is no technician in my room (while the cleaner didn't even came to my room). I asked them to find me another room, they said they were fully booked. But I insisted as I haven't had enough sleep after my back-of-clock international flight, after few arguments they moved me to another room. And then it doesn't stopped there. On October 26th, they messaged me to explain about check out time and regulations as I'm checking out on October 27th. It does say they offer LATE CHECK OUT with additional payment. I messaged the Venus Group Hotel to ask for late check out, they refused. And I insisted because I will be home late due to a concert I attend the night before. After few arguments, I finally allowed to do late check out with extra payment. They warned me by saying this is an exemption cause they normally not allowing someone to do late check out. If it so, why do they offer it in the first place though? Very passive aggressive behaviour for someone who run a business in hospitality industry. It might be the cheapest option out there, but beware as their very bad service will cause you a BIG headache for the entire trip. All of this inconvenience was recorded on my Whatsapp. 10/10 WOULDN'T RECCOMMEND.

positive_text: Close to the harbour and the opera house. Would not feel very safe at night.
negative_text: Very old pictures used - please don't believe what you see, as the hostel is run down now, a lot of things are broken, it needs to be shut down and properly refurbished. The hostel changed from 'all female' to 'mixed', and many females were forced to stay in mixed rooms even though they originally booked and expected females only in their room. After males moved in in September it took the management 4 weeks to fix the gaps between the door and the frame for toilets and showers. You could easily see a person through the 2cm gap on both sides of the doors. Some showers are without locks. They economy on liquid soap by adding 80% water. All kitchen knives are blunt. Some are bent at the end of the knife. Your unexpired food can be taken out of the fridge by the cleaners in the middle of a week for no reason. Not enough space to fit everyone in one common (from two houses) area for dinner. Literally everyone that comes in on the first day feels lost at how to check in and get into their room. Some guests only receive they door codes when already at the property, despite the fact that the payment was taken days earlier. For some guests room number was changed as they were literally trying to enter a previously advised room. So they had to go to a different room. No clean towels provided in the kitchen. Either no towels or the 'fresh' towels stink like they were never properly washed. Absolutely NO such basics provided as salt, tea, sugar, etc. The breakfast is very basic. Better buy it yourself. The dinner is terrible. The taste and the look. Not worth it. Made by a 'chef' apparently. Better make your own dinner. In some rooms it is not possible to open a window for fresh air - some guests were literally suffocating there.

negative_text: Some tips to future travelers. 1). I would say there is no reception in this property so you need to manage your payment online. Make sure you have enough fund in the bank card and the card can do online transactions on the day you check in. 2). You can send the photo id to mailto:reception@venushostels.com.au. In this way they will do the check in for you so no need to download the app. 3). There is no support for the travelers on-site as there is almost no staffing. Make sure to bring the following for the convenience: towel, lock, slippers, toothbrush, comb, thick clothes, food containers, pyjamas, washing gear, soap, etc. 4). Building 143 front door is somewhat broken, you need to smash the door first and input the password. 5). Building 143 has one bathroom with a toilet on the ground floor. Building 141 has 3 toilets and 3 showers on the ground floor, and additional bathroom on the second floor. Two outdoor bathrooms behind building 141. 6). The wifi signal is not strong enough to cover all the rooms.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Potts Point - Near Kings Cross Station
review_title: An okey option for one night, but there are better options to find
positive_text: The hostel is in a lovely area, it's lively but not loud, cosy and easily reachable. There are plenty of nice cafes and streets to stroll around. The overall cleanliness was pretty good, it seemed that they had one worker who was constantly cleaning around. Also, the fridges were surprisingly spacious and not filled with paper bags but with containers instead - easy and clean.
negative_text: This place is lacking space, big time. If you were thinking of bringing your laptop and doing, perhaps, some work with it - think twice. There is just not enough space for that, it's a very tight space! And there are no sockets. I think I managed to count 3 sockets that were constantly occupied. If you still insist on doing so, bring an extension cord, like a 10-meter-long extension cord. Believe me, you want this extension cord since there are also no sockets near your bed. Also maybe bring a night lamp, since there are no lamps near the bed, only one very bright ceiling lamp. My room (2 people room) happened to be just opposite the laundry room and oh man that space was loud. Also, I think it was the only room where you had to enter from outside and that was the only entry option, no matter if you went to the toilets, to showers, etc. Beware that the walls are very(!) thin. If you are a light sleeper, take thick earplugs with you. It's a cheap place, you get what you pay for but for sure there are better options around.

negative_text: Horrible experience checking in with Reyna and Sophia. I messaged them at 11:00 in the morning to let them know that I wanted dinner. I also completed the online check-in, uploaded all my details, and was told I would receive a door code. I arrived at the hotel at 7:00 pm and immediately emailed them and sent messages through Booking.com. Reyna ignored these messages until 7:42 pm. When I finally spoke to her, I was given a series of different and contradictory explanations. First, I was told that none of my emails or Booking.com messages had been received. When I showed her evidence that they had been sent, the explanations changed. I was then kept waiting for another 15 minutes while further explanations were given. I finally got through the door at around 8:00 pm. I went to get the dinner I had requested earlier, only to find that there was no dinner available. I went back to reception to speak to Reyna, and again I was given a series of explanations that contradicted what I had previously been told. I was left standing at reception with all my bags until approximately 8:20 pm. Reyna then gave me the wrong door code and refused to provide the contact details for her manager or supervisor. By contrast, the gentleman who is normally on the screen on a Friday night has always been excellent and provides a completely different level of customer service. My impression was that Reyna was worried about her handling of the situation being exposed, which is why I felt I was given different explanations, my questions weren't properly answered, and I was refused the manager's email address. This was an absolutely horrible experience. The whole situation was unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. Reyna's handling of the situation was extremely poor.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
review_title: Muy buena ubicación y relación calidad-precio, con algunos detalles operativos
room_type: Mixed Pod 6 Beds Room with Shared Bathroom
positive_text: La ubicación es excelente: está muy bien conectado y se puede llegar fácilmente desde el aeropuerto en metro, prácticamente sales de la estación y estás ahí. Las habitaciones son cómodas para ser un hostel, con buen ambiente y huéspedes respetuosos. Tiene buen WiFi, cocina equipada para guardar comida, varias duchas y baños disponibles, y servicios como lavandería que hacen la estancia práctica. En general, ofrece una muy buena relación calidad-precio considerando lo céntrico que es.
negative_text: El acceso con equipaje puede ser incómodo, ya que hay escaleras y las habitaciones están en el segundo o tercer piso, y esto podría comunicarse mejor en el anuncio para que los huéspedes estén más preparados. Tampoco es muy práctico el servicio de storage gratuito que ofrecen: tuve que caminar hasta otra propiedad de la misma cadena, lo que implicó una subir la cuestas de Surry Hills y es una caminata de unos 30 minutos, pero es más rápido si se hace en Uber. El sistema de recepción es remoto (pantallas con atención desde fuera del país), lo que puede hacer el check-in más lento o confuso. Además, las puertas con código a veces fallan, lo cual puede ser incómodo. Finalmente, al estar en una zona con vida nocturna, puede haber algo de ruido los fines de semana, y la limpieza es correcta pero no impecable.

review_title: Wet carpet, stinky room, unhelpful staff - wouldn't recommend at all
negative_text: I arrived to my room and found that the carpet was very wet and as a result the room smelled extremely musty and mouldy. I couldn't take my shoes off in the room or I would soak my feet and socks. When I raised the issue with the accommodation, they did the bare minimum by putting a towel on the floor (half the room's carpet was wet) and leaving a bottle of disinfectant spray. No alternative room was arranged, and there was no initiative to offer compensation in any way. When I asked the issue to be escalated to management, they said it'd take 7-10 business days and when I waited 10 business days I had to follow up again because I hadn't heard anything. This place clearly thinks they can offer poor services and get away with it. I know they offer cheap rooms, so I was expecting something quite modest and minimal, but a room with a soaking wet floor is a whole new level of poor quality. Do NOT recommend.
