property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
review_title: I went to the room and left
room_type: Mixed Pod Twin with Ensuite Bathroom
positive_text: I don't have any positive feedback. I found the info on the page confusing and the experience frustrating
negative_text: I turned up to the room and I thought I had booked a room with 2 bunk beds and a private bathroom. It said twin so I thought I had booked for the 2 people even though I was traveling on my own. I wanted to book the room for myself and was happy to pay for both. The price looked to be double the single person rate. But someone else, a stranger, was already sleeping in the bottom bunk when I arrived. I have back issues so the top bunk was not very easy for me and I had thought I would be able to use the bottom bunk when I made the booking. I recently did a similar thing at another place in Bondi. It was only 9pm and the other person already had their stuff literally all over the place, in the room, the kitchenette and the bathroom, and they were already asleep in the bottom bunk. They also had the aircon blaring on some hot setting so the room was like an oven. I tried to message the chat as there was no staff there that I could find and they took ages to reply. I asked if there was another room I could change to and they said no they were already booked. I asked for a locker I could use to put my personal things in with a lock. They finally replied and said there was a locker but you have to bring your own lock. Which I didn't have with me... and I did not see info about this on the pages or messages/emails. It was very heavy rain outside so I sat in the kitchen for a bit to try and figure out what to do.. I decided to book a room at another hotel near by which was expensive but I needed to be able to sleep for the next day of work and not have to sleep in some kind of sauna with a stranger and no security for my belongings. I don't usually leave negative reviews but I was really put out with this experience. They did try to apologise on the chat and offer me a different private room for another night with a small discount but I was only staying one night in Sydney for work. Much clearer info on the page would have helped.

It was very heavy rain outside so I sat in the kitchen for a bit to try and figure out what to do.. I decided to book a room at another hotel near by which was expensive but I needed to be able to sleep for the next day of work and not have to sleep in some kind of sauna with a stranger and no security for my belongings. I don't usually leave negative reviews but I was really put out with this experience. They did try to apologise on the chat and offer me a different private room for another night with a small discount but I was only staying one night in Sydney for work. Much clearer info on the page would have helped.

review_title: Smelly, dirty, tiny, not like photos. Potential bed bugs. Avoid at all costs.
room_type: Mixed Pod 4 People Bedroom with Ensuite Bathroom
positive_text: Worst place I’ve stayed in Oz by far. Ratings must be from bots, check Google reviews and they’re really low. Photos misleading. After traveling for 3 days I arrive to a room that was really smelly, that deep feet and smelly socks smell, looks like it hasn’t been cleaned or freshened up for days, there’s peoples belongings literally all over the place and I don’t even have enough space to open my luggage, a small surf bag, the place is so tiny, literally so small. The aircon was right beside my bed by my head and it was full of dust and dirt, pumping air right into my nostrils. Disgusting. Furniture old and worn out.
negative_text: People living there treating it like their own bedroom and the staff (staff, what staff!?) do nothing about it. “Thanks for your patience” is all they had to say to me via text. Woke up to a guest asking for his mattress to be changed because he had been itchy for a few days and full of bites, potentially bed bugs. 24h later and the management was still unaware as I had contacted them again to express my discontent. Had to deep clean all my clothes and belongings upon departure. Also, there’s signs everywhere saying you’ll get a fine of you break any rules. Everywhere, it’s so unwelcoming. $100 dollar fine for not doing the dishes? My god is that ridiculous. No alcohol allowed on premises so no glass of wine over dinner, bizarre. Breakfast is peanut butter and jam and they ran out of jam. Usually not a big deal but c’mon. No plant based milk alternative. No staff to be seen in sight, the breakfast person/morning cleaner young kid, really kind but shy and avoids eye contact. Who is responsible for this place?? Any enquiry via text is answering by AI. Absolutely terrible experience. Avoid at all costs.

Also really like that they have the curtains for privacy for each bed. Electric outlets at each bed.
negative_text: Not enough common areas which can be difficult for perennial snackers like me as we're also not allowed to consume food in our rooms. I was given a top bunk which unfortunately creaked quite a bit on my way up/down despite me weighing less than 50kg. The draws under the bed could be better sized. They were just a bit too wide so that they couldn't be open at the same time as my bunkmate's. Could use an extra shelf in the locker (they had those before but were removed on this stay even if i was staying in the exact same room). More hooks in the bathroom would be nice too. Some small holes on the wall by my bed where a shelf probably used to be--hope they can cover this up.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
review_title: If you're looking for a reliable, clean, and convenient place to stay, this is a fantastic choice.
room_type: Mixed Pod Twin with Shared Bathroom
positive_text: In January I spent a night at this hostel, and I can confidently say it exceeded my expectations in every way. As someone traveling through the city on a tight schedule, I couldn’t have asked for a better base. This hostel truly lives up to its name—everything is central and within easy reach. Whether you're heading out to explore the city, catch a train, or find a quick bite, the location makes everything simple and stress-free. From the moment I arrived, the check-in process was smooth and efficient. I was especially impressed by the remote reception system, which is available 24/7. It made late arrival and general communication a breeze—no waiting around or confusion. It’s clear that the staff here are not only organized, but also genuinely care about the guests. My room was clean and well-kept, with fresh sheets and a bed that was surprisingly comfortable—just the right firmness for a great night’s sleep. I appreciated the quiet atmosphere at night, which is especially important when you're trying to recharge. One small detail that really stood out was how accurate the online photos were. It's always a gamble booking places based on pictures, but in this case, what I saw online was exactly what I got. That level of transparency built even more trust and added to my overall satisfaction.

positive_text: I wouldn’t recommend this hostel. Unfortunately, my stay was quite disappointing. From the start, it was inconvenient—I had to carry my suitcase up two flights of stairs. The rooms were very warm at night, and cleanliness was lacking. I stayed in a room with a shared bathroom for nearly a week, and it didn’t seem to be cleaned at all during that time. Basic amenities like body soap and shampoo weren’t provided, so after a long flight, I had to use hand soap to shower. There were also no hair dryers available. There’s no staff on-site, so if you have any issues, you need to message them and wait for a response. The walls are quite thin, so noise carries easily. If guests are talking late at night or moving luggage around—which happened often—you’ll hear it, even with earplugs. Unlike many hostels that offer USB ports at each bunk for convenience, this one doesn’t, so be sure to bring a converter. I originally booked this place to save a little money because the photos looked promising, but unfortunately, it didn’t live up to expectations. The one positive is its location—it’s close to Central Station, making it easy to get around. However, for a more comfortable stay, I’d recommend looking elsewhere.

review_title: If you have standards, steer clear.
room_type: Female Only Pod 6 Beds Room - Ensuite
positive_text: The location was good. Other than that we couldn't find more positives.
negative_text: The check-in process is automated and you are supposed to fill out a form online, which we didn't recieve in the first place. When we arrived at the hostel, there is no reception or a staff to help you check in or clarify, so we had to call a number and wait for the code to the main door, to be assigned a bed and code to our room. Through this form you also fill out if you want dinner or not, so we could not register fo that either in advance. Upon opening the front door to the hostel, there is a hallway SHARED with a restaurant next door, which has it's bathrooms there - right under the staircase leading to the hostel kitchen and "common area", so anyone has access to the hallway and the acomm in general, not mentioning the noise and constant traffic. The common room where you can have dinner consists of one biger and one small table, so if you want dinner when it's served to you, you are most likely to be sitting on the steps or have to find a place to eat somewhere else, since the common area is full with roughly 12 people sitting there. The whole feel of the hostel is claustrophobic, it is grimy, the bathrooms and toilets are combined, unisex, not clean and there are definitely not enough. The walls are so thin you can hear someone using the bathroom from your bed. The bedrooms smell and our beds looked like someone slept in them or just didn't bother to make them right. Over all I am glad I just booked one night and did not have to stay at this nightmare institution longer and spend more money there. This is the worst hostel in Australia I have ever stayed in.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
room_type: Female Only Pod 6 Beds Room - Ensuite
positive_text: 地點 Location 交通非常方便從機場搭火車兩站就到了，帶著大行李建議搭到博物館站，到飯店的路才會是下坡路比較輕鬆呦！從車站到住宿地點大約走路5-8分鐘，非常方便，門口是大條馬路，一樓就有便利商店，即使深夜也安全和明亮。 硬體設備 Facility No reception. 大門和房間門都是密碼鎖，no elevator/lift. 行李很大的旅客請注意！房間位於公寓二樓和三樓，二樓有交誼廳和廚房。冰箱很大，也有固定清理，非常乾淨。廚房廚具一應俱全，可以自己煮完全沒問題，整潔有員工維護，非常完善。房間內有衛浴，房間外也有，非常方便。房間浴室間乾淨，提供洗手乳。熱水來的很快，水力也很充足！沒有提供吹風機，要記得自行攜帶。床邊有插座，充電方便。有置物櫃但是需要自行攜帶鎖。房間空間不大，行李箱攤開拿完東西需要收起來。床下也有置物空間。 服務 Service 有負責清潔和準備早餐晚餐的員工，都非常親切，一切也都運作的很棒很順利！有任何問題，也可以透過app(Booking.com/Goki)聯繫住宿方員工，都能及時得到回應與協助。 在此住了5天，每天都有機會在交誼廳和其他旅客，員工聊天交流，雖然地方不大，但真的很溫馨很舒服，不是特別豪華的地方，但住了五天要離開還真又點捨不得，是很像家的舒適放鬆感。交通地點也方便，非常推薦大家來！

room_type: Bed in 4-Bed Dormitory Room with Ensuite Bathroom (Female Only)
positive_text: Easy to get to, simple check-in, felt pretty secure and I appreciated the no talking in rooms rule. Encourages people to sit out in the main area - though the main area is quite small from what I saw. Great blockout curtains, and I had a little aircon remote next to my bed. I forgot to use it, but nice to have. Awesome that for the price you can also get dinner included - I wish I'd downloaded the check in app sooner; I didn't realise you'd need to register to be included (but makes sense!). The app was a surprise, too, but I found I liked using it. Staff were very quick & responsive when I had a question. Having an ensuite connected to the room is awesome - it's a tiny bathroom, but it was nice and reduces the chance of waiting. There were several other bathrooms nearby if needed, so no issue there. Found the bed quite comfy! The pillow was great, the mattress quite firm - in a good way. I usually like a softer mattress, but it wasn't a problem at all. Great location too - very easy to get to and from the airport and walk to other areas; also easy walking distance (under 20 mins) to heaps of art galleries.
negative_text: I found it strange how high up the ladders/steps were for the bunk beds. I'm usually all about climbing and top bunking, but found it quite awkward to climb up and down. That was it really! I was only there for one night, so had very little exposure to anything else. Not really a dislike, but worth knowing: you can't store your belongings onsite for more than 2 hours after checkout, but that's because they have tight security protocol. Not something I'd ask to change. You're already getting a pretty great deal anyway - so it would have just topped it off if that was possible. Oh, and I was very nervous about my phone battery dying and not being able to get into the hostel/my room if something happened to my phone, but it just meant I committed the backup code to memory all the more. I didn't see if there was a solution to this, but there would be one available I'm sure.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
review_title: Very clean hostel but not a lot of room, but close to everything. Overall a convenient place
positive_text: I stayed at the hostel in a 6 women bunk room for a month and half in the winter. Their provided meals for breakfast and dinner where always good and the people serving were always so nice. I really enjoyed the cleanliness of the hostel. It was always for the most part taken very well care of. I liked the kitchen supplies were supplied, including tea kettles and a toaster. If there were large issues maintenance cleared it up very quickly and they were always responsive, reachable, and helpful through the WhatsApp. The water was always hot. And wifi was very fast and easy to use and the blackout curtains on each bunk was so nice and created excellent privacy. The location was very very convenient. Across the street from Central Station and the major bus stop. Also close to the bars and nightlife so it was easy to just walk over. Very close to convenience stores and 7min walk to large shopping malls and grocery stores like, Coles. It was directly located on top of a Thai restaurant which was just kind of cool to tell people. I never tried it but smelled good. And you could never smell it or hear the noise from inside.
negative_text: Sometimes the staff had an attitude which made you feel uncomfortable at times, my one experience with that was in the morning. There's no common room just a kitchen and dining room with only 6 chairs, which led a lot of people having to eat their food standing around the room. It is a lot smaller than the photos led you on to believe it is. There is not a lot of room for people to store groceries and no freezer or oven. I traveled during the winter for a month and stayed in a 6 women bunk room on the top floor and there was no source of heat so you were freezing each night. There's no reception and you just have to message them on the WhatsApp, which was fine with me but a lot of older residents had a lot of trouble. There's no signs so the building is hard to find and there's no instructions on how to check out. Very small hostel so it felt very cramped at times and didn't have places for people to sit because there wasn't a common room. People could only talk in the kitchen or in the stairwells which made it cramped as well. If you are staying on the top bunk they are almost impossible to get into. Very hard to get up the ladder and dangerous at times. Right next to a tobacco shop which was fine, but there was always a homeless woman outside of it that would yell at people walking by.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
room_type: Bed in 6-Bed Dormitory Room with Ensuite Bathroom (Female Only)
positive_text: I loved that breakfast and dinner was provided. The privacy curtains which were a beautiful blackout velvet, the doona was lovely. The people were lovely. The fact it was FEMALE ONLY. There was an ensuite and lots of bathrooms, showers and toilets. There was a washing machine and dryer in one of the bathrooms.The common area and kitchen are so aesthetically pleasing and comfortable. There's lots of fridges for people to put their food in. Containers, labels and pens are provided. There's also an awesome pretty dry storage pantry in the kitchen for people to put their dry foodstuffs in with containers, labels and pens provided. The kitchen is gorgeous with beautiful teal splash back and gold fittings. It's just gorgeous. There's a kettle, microwave, oven, induction cook tops, toaster. It's really great. There's beautiful art on the wall of Australian animals. The lounge is adorable and so comfy with a gorgeous crocheted cover. There's power points/sockets in all the right places next to your bed, in the bathrooms, in the kitchen and in the common area. Its all clean and free of any luggage or bags or clutter. Very clean. They have lovely lockers if you bring your own lock, the size is really good and they even have shelves inside the lockers. There's aircon and electric fans in the rooms which is nice. The lighting throughout the hostel is really nice not too bright and not too yellow or dim its just right. Everyone is very quiet and respects the quiet hours which is fantastic. The shower head and taps are lovely modern pieces and work very well. Water pressure is great. They are really responsive via the Goki app and hostel staff are super friendly and helpful. The information they give you at the beginning of your stay about great places to visit, eat and explore in Sydney. Its super helpful.
negative_text: The pillow filling was really bad it gave me neck pain. The floors of the bathrooms need to be repainted. They need a fold up table and chairs for the common area because there isn't enough. They need to add the breakfast to the Goki app and an advertisement for the dinner next to the breakfast one in the common area so residents know about it. They need to label the drawers under the beds so that the bottom bunk cant monopolise both. But also putting it in the information on check-in that you are entitled to use one of the drawers under the bunk bed. The banister on the stairs from the entrance to the common room is unsteady and a safety hazard. There should be a grab point for the top bunk so you can grab onto something when transitioning from the ladder to the actual bed. (For safety) putting a handle on the framing just above the ladder would be perfect.

positive_text: This clean hostel is located close to the Museum train station and a short walk from Surry Hill, Chinatown and Darling Square. The rooms were quite clean and I saw the bathroom being cleaned every morning. It is a quiet hostel so if you are someone looking to stay somewhere with little to no noise in the rooms then this is the place for you. Curtains on the bunk beds ensure privacy. Overall, decent value for the money you pay and a safe hostel for solo female travelers.
negative_text: There were definitely some pertinent issues. First, you need to bring your own toiletries and towels because there is a charge for them. Next, the ensuite bathroom in the 2 person-shared room was extremely tiny with only one hook to hang clothes on. I found that quite inconvenient. There is no reception or staff on-site and you can only interact with them using the Goki app (this is also how they recommend checking in but I did not need it). Hence, an early check-in or late check-out becomes difficult. If you wish to check out later, you can leave your luggage in the shared space but you should be comfortable leaving it out in the open since there is no one to guard it for you. The kitchen sink was a bit unclean a couple of times. Finally, they should consider installing a charging port next to the bed.

positive_text: The beds are comfortable and proper blankets are provided, which is nice on Sydney in winter. The lockers were large enough to fit a medium size backpacking pack. The kitchen was clean enough.
negative_text: The hostel has a very sketchy and creepy vibe. There is no reception and the management will only get in contact with you via text or an app. You have to check yourself in and download an app to use a digital key. There is no way to ring someone inside the hostel. Inside the place is plastered with warnings of what is prohibited to do and how much you will be finded. For example, A$ 250 for taking a phone call in the room and A$ 100 for leaving a dirty dish out. There are cameras everywhere observing every angle, nook and cranny of the place. It feels like one is constantly being watched while not getting to see the people who are behind the cameras. Any message I received from the hostel was related to money. After my stay I received a message that I should leave a 9 to 10/10 rating. Also, the bathrooms are completely run down and filthy. Lastly, the hostel seems to have changed its name. I booked it under the name "Pod hostel", but received confirmation for the Venus hostel. The former is supposed to be a mixed hostel and the latter is a female only hostel. This only added to the confusion upon check in.

review_title: I was made to feel like a criminal, so uncomfortable
room_type: Bed in 4-Bed Dormitory Room with Ensuite Bathroom (Female Only)
positive_text: Good location, girls in my room were lovely. Very clean compared to most hostels.
negative_text: Unfortunately I would have to say I didn’t have a very good experience at Venus Central hostel. Whilst I appreciate the standard of hygiene being one of best iv seen for a hostel, this is maintained in an overbearing way, impeding on my privacy. For that reason it has been my worst hostel experience. I felt under constant surveillance, making me very uncomfortable. One morning i had cleaners come in taking pictures or my things. This was shortly followed by a message to an app directly to our room. By no means was my property hazardous to anyone, my shoes and bag were next to my bed, in no one’s way. A slight eyesore for a short time, as if just got in from the cold, jumped in the shower then quickly into bed to warm up. By this time cleaners were in my room, so I couldn’t get dressed or rearrange. It was really unreasonable and an huge invasion privacy. I think the most surprising for me was when checking out. A person (assuming staff) was standing outside my room on the phone messaging again. I checked my room for the final time, was followed in and she left immediately after I did. So i think it’s fair to assume they were just making sure I was leaving. I felt like a criminal with someone there waiting for me to leave. I had no idea who the staff team was during my entire time, so there wasn’t anyone to discuss things with. I don’t think they have anyone managing at the property tbh. Most people I spoke had no clue- it was the blind leading the blind I wasn’t able to relax and just felt like I was always being watched and reported. Rules of the house are over emphasised with messages and posters all of the place. Rules which I respect, but it was just too much. A poster in the room stating if you were caught on your phone in the room you’ll be removed of the premises 😂🙈. Extreme.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
review_title: Met all my needs with some minor problems
positive_text: Although it’s scary not having any staff in person to communicate with when problems arise, the staff responded promptly when you messaged them online. My stay was comfortable and if you’re like me in that when you travel you don’t care too much about where you stay because you’re out most of the day and just need somewhere to shower and sleep then this place is perfect. The bed is comfy - just be aware that the blanket they provide is not sufficient for winter. The other girls staying there were nice and respectful and I felt secure leaving my luggage at the place every day. It’s also in such a convenient location which I feel is one of the best parts about staying here. You’re close to all the main attractions in Sydney and I enjoyed being in walking distance to everywhere I wanted to visit. It felt safe walking back here at night.
negative_text: The cleanliness of the place was just not bad. I wouldn’t say the place is clean. For me, the cleanliness of the bed and bathrooms were the most important. The bed was clean, but the bathrooms were visibly a bit grimy. Two of the bathrooms are inconveniently arranged; the toilet, sink and shower are strangely positioned and don’t have places to hang your towel or put your toiletries while you shower. The third bathroom is well arranged and has ample space though. The water temperature is really hard to adjust though. My shower took so much longer because every few minutes the water would just go cold and you had to wait a few minutes for it to warm up again. Sleeping might be difficult for light sleepers since you’re next to a main road and it’s constantly really noisy even through the night. For me it wasn’t too much of a problem and I feel like it’s a sacrifice you make to be close to the city. A small problem I had was not having blinds for my bed. I didn’t mind because I wasn’t doing much in my bed other than sleeping and the other girls in my room respected my privacy but it would have been nice to have them for the extra privacy. Another small problem was not being aware I needed a lock to use the in-room lockers before arriving. It was a minor problem but it would have been nice to not take time out to buy a new lock when I could’ve brought one from home if I knew.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
review_title: Terrible customer experience (and I'm not a difficult customer!)
positive_text: Great location (there's plenty of other hostels in the area - go somewhere else) - Cleaning team does a good job - Girls staying at the hostel are respectful to one another.
negative_text: The management of that place is AWFUL ! I had booked a bed in a 4 bed-room, for 6 nights. I did this booking 6 days in advance. ON THE DAY of my arrival, one of the employee called me to tell me that they had overbooked so I had a "choice" : either stay in a 6 bed-room, be put in another of their hostels (not convenient for me geographically) or cancelling the booking all together! I was travelling at that moment and had to deal with this for 45min. I checked other possibilities, but of course, because of the short notice, all the other properties were fully booked, so I had no choice but to accept to stay in the 6 bed-room. When I asked what would be done to make it up to me, they told me "we will reimburse the difference of price. 35$ overall" I said that this was the logical thing to do (even if that price difference was ridiculous - again, 35$ over 6nights!!!), but that it wasn't what I meant, because I was expecting a goodwill gesture for 1) the inconvenience of having to stay in a bigger room 2) the stress and the time it added to my trip. The person replied that nothing could be done and that if I wasn't happy, again, I "had the choice" to cancel. After long negotiations where I asked to talk to the management (I could sense the employee was under pressure and could do nothing even if she wanted to - don't blame her), she told me she would try to get back to me with a real peace offering. Later that day, I received a... 10$ voucher to spend on another stay in one of their properties. What a joke. I've contacted Booking but nothing has been resolved yet. And I'm STILL WAITING for my 35$ difference! This is what happens when businesses decide to do everything from a remote office - No-one feels accountable and guests are left feeling like mere financial transactions rather than valued individuals.

negative_text: I love that it's female only, but there were a few things that weren't female friendly. There was only one toilet/shower on each floor, for 7 rooms of people to share...that's a lot of people. There was no mirror in the bathroom, no hangers in the shower, so everything either got wet on the ground or you had to hang everything you had over the door. I don't like to bring businesses down but it did feel a bit 'green washing' for a female hostel to not be female friendly at all.

property_name: Azzurro Pod Hotel Central Sydney - Near Central Station
room_type: Bed in 2-Bed Dormitory Room with Shared Bathroom (Female Only)
positive_text: Location
negative_text: I have never left a negative review for a hostel before and I've stayed in many. However, this hostel was a headache from start to finish. You need wifi to checkin since you have to scan the QR code on the door to get the check in details and wifi password. The hostel is tiny, borderline claustrophobic. Common area is a small table with four chairs that is always full so good luck being able to eat since you also can't keep food in the room. No amenities or onsite reception. There's guests that live here long term so they're always in the room or using the lne table as a desk to work. Asked their virtual reception for towel upon arrival, $10 deposit that I had to follow up multiple times after checkout to get back. I stayed in the 2 bed dorm which was essentially the size of a closet. Too small even for one person. No sink in room despite what it says. Portable AC was essentially a fan. Ridiculously hot on the top bunk in 32 degree weather. Traffic noise made it impossible to sleep so did the bunk creaking loudly with every movement. Nowhere to hang clothes or keep phone (which you need to open your room) in the shower on the second floor. Definitely not what I expected based on the reviews and photos.

positive_text: The only thing i liked about the property was it’s amazing location 🙌🏼
negative_text: The space was really small and very uncomfortable. It is women only hostel, with only 4 showers and toilets (wc and shower together) for all of us. There was no mirror in the room. Also bathroom floors are repainted black and this color is now peeling off and you take it everywhere with you + showers are so close to the toilet without the screen, that afterwards it’s all completely soaked. If you have any questions there is no reception as everything is online. The pictures and idea of the hostel it gives is very misleading. One of the worst hostel experiences ever so far, which makes me sad.

positive_text: It's my worst experience for hostel in Australia so far, the most regret thing is booked this hostel for my first time visit Sydney. 1,very complicated check in, remember, you have to download an App, email them all your details first, you have to follow up all the time, otherwise you can't get the digital code into the building especially in night time. And, I paid aud59 for one night. 6There is no space to stock your luggage safety, no customer service at all. All I want to say thank you is the cleaner, she did all the customer work on site.

I just had a bad luck for this time, I arrived in Sydney late at night and was really tired from the flight so I wanted to sleep as soon as possible. So I needed to contact them in WhatsApp and waited for their reply and wait until the bed was ready, it took more than 1 hour. If there was someone working in there, it didn't take that long. And also there's no luggage storage service before/after check in/out.
